purpose: P10 isolated financial history TMP; not Base22 or consumer admission
prerequisites: complete original July ODS raw members with original manifest identity
complete qualified current raw/typed captures and actual two cold receipts

equal_version_rule: Same provider/revision, exact complete report body, same qualified parent availability floor, and all typed non-provenance/non-publication/non-end atoms equal. Preserve native version; retain complete incoming capture in local evidence. This grants no conflicting value priority.
knowledge_from: Keep the existing model max(original provider observation, dated company identity availability). Actual acquisition clocks remain separate in original raw evidence; a common parent floor never makes two acquisitions identical.
publication_precision: Only an original raw date-only token and its exact legacy derived Shanghai end-of-day bound authorize published_at=NULL. Retain the raw date token, complete body, old bound and actual repair observation in local evidence. Genuine timestamp instants remain unchanged.
knowledge_to: Close only at the exact next kept same-business-key knowledge clock when earlier than the original end; preserve finite gaps.
proof: Cold rederive the shared bridge once from all local original/current raw members and pinned dated parent mapping, then compare every retained typed atom in each year. Verify global keys, intervals, all report/fact parents, schema and physical partition set separately.
representation: Original typed captures and raw evidence are independent entity files. Sort only keys, clocks and row ordinals; stream typed Parquet. No full-history JSON/SQLite, source links, external fallback or READY.
